title: Update Favicon on All Pages
description: Ensure all pages (playgrounds, sketchpad, etc.) use the updated semio logo as favicon.
summary: Switched favicon source from round emblem to compact `emblem.svg` (same geometry as `SemioLogo` in playground navbar). Updated `semioFaviconSources` to use `emblem.svg` + `favicon_32x32.ico`, regenerated the ICO from the compact emblem, and refreshed sketchpad `public/` favicon copies.
